lesson.title: 關鍵時刻／真正接受考驗的時刻
lesson.titleZh: 關鍵時刻／真正接受考驗的時刻

examples.en: The final interview will be the moment of truth for Nathan.
examples.zh: 最後面試將會是彌敦真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

examples.en: The moment of truth will come when the judges announce the result.
examples.zh: 當評判公布結果時，成敗揭曉的關鍵時刻便會來臨。

meaning.en: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.
meaning.zh: 一個重要而具決定性的時刻；某個人、計劃、產品、能力或努力真正接受考驗，而結果、實際表現或未來發展即將揭曉。

register.summaryEn: everyday conversations; school and workplace discussions; presentations and interviews; sports reports; news and general writing; stories describing an important test or decision.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬中性，但帶有較強的強調作用。 它可以自然用於日常對話、學校及工作討論、簡報、訪問、體育報道、新聞及一般文章。
contextsEn: stories describing an important test or decision
register.formalEn: Use the idiom only in the contexts described in the source.
register.formalZh: 只在原檔說明的合適情境中使用這個慣用語。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.form: X + be + the moment of truth + for + person, plan or thing.
forms.example: The final interview will be the moment of truth for Nathan.

forms.form: The moment of truth + come / arrive + when + clause.
forms.example: The moment of truth will come when the judges announce the result.

forms.form: Subject + reach / face / approach + the moment of truth.
forms.example: The team has reached the moment of truth.

forms.form: At the moment of truth, + subject + action.
forms.example: At the moment of truth, Clara remained calm.
Now comes the moment of truth: we are switching on the machine.

examples.en: The final interview will be the moment of truth for Nathan.

examples.en: The moment of truth will come when the judges announce the result.
examples.zh: 當評判公布結果時，成敗揭曉的關鍵時刻便會來臨。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式三：來到或面對關鍵時刻
specificForms.formula: Subject + reach / face / approach + the moment of truth.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + reach / face / approach + the moment of truth.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + reach / face / approach + the moment of truth。

examples.zh: 團隊已來到真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：At the moment of truth, + subject + action。

examples.en: At the moment of truth, Clara remained calm.
examples.zh: 在真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻，克拉拉仍保持冷靜。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式五：營造即將揭曉的感覺
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: the moment of truth.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：the moment of truth。

examples.en: Now comes the moment of truth: we are switching on the machine.
examples.zh: 關鍵時刻到了：我們正要開啟機器。

benefits.en: The expression does more than say that something is being tested. It suggests that the result matters and will reveal whether the earlier preparation was successful. The final match will be the moment of truth for the team.
benefits.zh: 這個表達不只是說明某事正在接受測試，還表示結果十分重要，並會顯示之前的準備是否成功。 第二句更能突出這場比賽將會決定球隊的成敗。

benefits.titleEn: It Connects Preparation with the Result
benefits.titleZh: 把準備工作與結果連繫起來
benefits.en: The expression is useful after somebody has studied, practised, planned, built or prepared something.
benefits.zh: 當某人已完成溫習、練習、計劃、製作或準備工作後，這個表達尤其實用。 經過六星期練習，今晚的演出將會是真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

examples.en: After six weeks of practice, tonight’s performance will be the moment of truth.
examples.zh: 經過六星期練習，今晚的演出將會是真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

benefits.en: This sentence tells the listener that an important result is about to become clear.
benefits.zh: 會告訴聽者，一項重要結果即將揭曉。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Describe People, Plans and Things
benefits.titleZh: 可以形容人、計劃及事物接受考驗
benefits.en: The weight test will be the moment of truth for the bridge.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以指出某個人、計劃、系統或物件真正接受考驗的一刻。

benefits.en: The idiom packages the ideas of testing, importance and revelation into one expression.
benefits.zh: 明天的測試將會是修理好的機器真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。 這個慣用語把「接受考驗」、「結果重要」和「真實表現即將顯現」幾個意思集中在一個表達之中。

examples.en: Tomorrow’s test will be the moment of truth for the repaired machine.
examples.zh: 明天的測試將會是修理好的機器真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

history.en: Merriam-Webster records the first known English use in 1932. The Online Etymology Dictionary also records the phrase in Ernest Hemingway’s 1932 book Death in the Afternoon and connects it with the Spanish bullfighting expression.
history.zh: Merriam-Webster 把目前所知最早的英語用法追溯至1932年。 《Online Etymology Dictionary》亦記錄 Ernest Hemingway 在1932年的著作 Death in the Afternoon 中使用這個短語，並把它與西班牙語的鬥牛用語連繫起來。

history.en: The original expression described an extreme and decisive test. English speakers later extended the image to examinations, performances, decisions, product tests and other situations in which success, failure or true quality becomes clear.
history.zh: 原來的表達形容一項極為重要而具決定性的考驗。 後來，英語使用者把這個意象延伸至考試、演出、決定、產品測試，以及其他成敗或真正表現即將揭曉的情境。

origin.memoryEn: At the moment of truth, preparation ends and the real test begins.
origin.memoryZh: 到了 the moment of truth，準備階段結束，真正的考驗正式開始。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：使用完全正確的固定形式
rules.zh: 使用完全正確的固定形式

rules.titleEn: There Must Be a Genuine Test
rules.titleZh: 規則二：必須存在真正的考驗
rules.en: The test has a meaningful result: Ella will either show that she is ready or show that she needs more practice. This is an ordinary check with no important result or consequence.
rules.zh: 最後路試將會是艾拉真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。 這項測試會帶來有意義的結果：艾拉會證明自己已準備好，或顯示她仍需要更多練習。 我檢查鉛筆是否夠尖。

examples.en: The final road test will be the moment of truth for Ella.
examples.zh: 最後路試將會是艾拉真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with Telling the Truth
rules.titleZh: 規則三：不要把它誤解為「說出真相」
rules.en: The word truth is part of the idiom, but the expression does not normally mean that somebody admits a secret or stops lying.
rules.zh: 雖然慣用語中有 truth 一字，但這個表達一般不是指某人承認秘密或停止說謊。 普里雅終於承認自己打破了杯子。

examples.en: This does not automatically create a natural opportunity to use the moment of truth.
examples.zh: 普里雅終於承認自己打破了杯子。

rules.titleEn: The Result or Real Quality Must Become Clear
rules.titleZh: 規則四：結果或真正表現必須即將顯現
rules.en: The new bridge looks strong, but tomorrow’s weight test will show whether it is safe.
rules.zh: 新橋看來很堅固，但明天的承重測試將會顯示它是否安全。 承重測試將會是新橋真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

examples.en: The weight test will be the moment of truth for the new bridge.
examples.zh: 承重測試將會是新橋真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：保留時態及確定程度
rules.en: Do not change could be into was. That would turn a possibility into a completed fact.
rules.zh: 不要把 could be 改成 was，否則會把可能性變成已完成的事實。

rules.titleEn: Use “For” to Name What Is Being Tested
rules.titleZh: 規則六：使用 for 指出接受考驗的人或事物
rules.en: Use “For” to Name What Is Being Tested
rules.zh: 使用 for 指出接受考驗的人或事物

rules.titleEn: Use “When” to Explain the Decisive Event
rules.titleZh: 規則七：使用 when 說明決定性的事件
rules.en: Use “When” to Explain the Decisive Event
rules.zh: 當機器開啟時，真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻便會來臨。

rules.titleEn: Use It for a Meaningful Outcome
rules.titleZh: 規則八：用於具有實際影響的結果
rules.en: examinations; interviews; performances; competitions; product tests; important decisions; project launches; safety tests; election results; the first real use of a plan or system.
rules.zh: 自然情境包括考試、面試、演出、比賽、產品測試、重要決定、項目推出、安全測試、選舉結果，以及計劃或系統首次正式使用。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Merely Because Something Happens Later
rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要只因某事稍後發生便使用
rules.en: Nothing about lunch tests a person, plan or result.
rules.zh: 午餐將會是關鍵時刻，因為它在早課之後。 午餐並沒有考驗某個人、計劃或結果。

examples.en: Lunch will be the moment of truth because it comes after the morning lesson.
examples.zh: 午餐將會是關鍵時刻，因為它在早課之後。

rules.en: The idiom is useful when the situation is genuinely decisive. For an ordinary event, test, check, try or result may be clearer.
rules.zh: 只有當情境確實具決定性時，這個慣用語才特別實用。 對於普通事件，使用 test、check、try 或 result 可能更加清楚。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using the moment of truth.
instructions.zh: 使用 the moment of truth 改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: Daniel has studied for three months. The final exam will show whether he is fully prepared.
questions.promptZh: 丹尼爾已溫習了三個月。期末考試將會顯示他是否已作好充分準備。
questions.answer: The final exam will be the moment of truth for Daniel after three months of study.
questions.answerZh: 經過三個月的溫習，期末考試將會是丹尼爾真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: Chloe is taking the cake out of the oven. She will now discover whether her new recipe works.
questions.promptZh: 克洛伊正把蛋糕從焗爐取出。她現在便會知道新食譜是否成功。
questions.answer: Taking the cake out of the oven is the moment of truth for Chloe’s new recipe.
questions.answerZh: 把蛋糕從焗爐取出的一刻，正是克洛伊的新食譜成敗揭曉的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The team has tested the app many times. Tomorrow, real users will show whether it is easy to use.
questions.promptZh: 團隊已多次測試這個應用程式。明天，真正的使用者將會顯示它是否容易使用。
questions.answer: Tomorrow’s first user test will be the moment of truth for the new app.
questions.answerZh: 明天的首次使用者測試，將會是這個新應用程式真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The score is level, and Ryan must take the final penalty kick. His kick will decide the match.
questions.promptZh: 比數打成平手，而賴恩必須主射最後一個十二碼。他這一腳將會決定賽果。
questions.answer: Ryan’s final penalty kick is the moment of truth in this level match.
questions.answerZh: 賴恩主射最後一個十二碼的一刻，正是這場平手賽事的成敗關鍵。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The students have waited two weeks. The first signs of growth will show whether their planting method works.
questions.promptZh: 學生已等待了兩星期。第一批生長跡象將會顯示他們的種植方法是否有效。
questions.answer: The first signs of growth will be the moment of truth for the students’ plant experiment.
questions.answerZh: 第一批生長跡象，將會是學生的植物實驗成敗揭曉的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: Sophie has practised for weeks. Her audition will show whether she is ready to join the school choir.
questions.promptZh: 蘇菲已練習了數星期。試音將會顯示她是否已準備好加入學校合唱團。
questions.answer: The audition will be the moment of truth for Sophie after weeks of practice.
questions.answerZh: 經過數星期的練習，這次試音將會是蘇菲真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: Leo has completed every part of his job application. The final interview will decide whether he gets the job.
questions.promptZh: 里奧已完成求職申請的每個部分。最後面試將會決定他能否獲得這份工作。
questions.answer: The final interview will be the moment of truth for Leo’s job application.
questions.answerZh: 最後面試將會是里奧這次求職申請成敗揭曉的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The mechanic has repaired the old fan. Switching it on will show whether the repair was successful.
questions.promptZh: 技工已修理好那部舊風扇。開啟風扇後，便會知道維修是否成功。
questions.answer: Switching on the repaired fan will be the moment of truth for the mechanic’s work.
questions.answerZh: 開啟修理好的風扇，將會是檢驗技工維修成果的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The class submitted its video last month. The competition result will be announced today.
questions.promptZh: 全班上個月提交了影片。比賽結果將於今天公布。
questions.answer: Today’s result announcement will be the moment of truth for the class video.
questions.answerZh: 今天公布結果的一刻，將會是這段班級影片成敗揭曉的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The company has worked hard on its new plan. Presenting it to the first customer will show whether it is convincing.
questions.promptZh: 公司一直努力制定新計劃。向第一位顧客介紹計劃後，便會知道它是否具說服力。
questions.answer: The presentation to the first customer will be the moment of truth for the company’s new plan.
questions.answerZh: 向第一位顧客介紹計劃，將會是公司新計劃真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: Before a new dish is added to the menu, the chef always tastes it one last time to decide whether it is ready.
questions.promptZh: 每道新菜式加入餐牌前，廚師總會作最後一次試味，以決定它是否已準備好推出。
questions.answer: The final taste is always the moment of truth for a new dish.
questions.answerZh: 最後一次試味，總是新菜式真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: Grace practised driving for months. Her road test showed whether she was ready to drive alone.
questions.promptZh: 格蕾絲練習駕駛了數月。路試顯示她是否已準備好獨自駕駛。
questions.answer: The road test was the moment of truth for Grace after months of practice.
questions.answerZh: 經過數月練習，路試就是格蕾絲真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The students have finished building their bridge model. Tomorrow, they will put heavy books on it to see whether it can hold the weight.
questions.promptZh: 學生已完成製作橋樑模型。明天，他們會把重書放在上面，看看它能否承受重量。
questions.answer: Tomorrow’s weight test will be the moment of truth for the bridge model.
questions.answerZh: 明天的承重測試，將會是這個橋樑模型真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The pupils have rehearsed the school play for six weeks. Tonight, they will perform it for a real audience for the first time.
questions.promptZh: 學生已為學校話劇綵排了六星期。今晚，他們將首次在真正的觀眾面前演出。
questions.answer: The moment of truth has finally arrived for the school play: opening night is here.
questions.answerZh: 學校話劇真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻終於來臨：首演之夜到了。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The outdoor picnic can go ahead if the weather stays dry on Saturday, but heavy rain would ruin the plan.
questions.promptZh: 如果星期六天氣保持乾爽，戶外野餐便可照常舉行；但大雨會破壞整個計劃。
questions.answer: Saturday’s weather may be the moment of truth for the outdoor picnic plan.
questions.answerZh: 星期六的天氣，可能會是戶外野餐計劃成敗的關鍵。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: We have practised every emergency step. Next week’s full drill should show whether our plan really works.
questions.promptZh: 我們已練習每一個緊急應變步驟。下星期的完整演習應可顯示計劃是否真正有效。
questions.answer: Next week’s full drill should be the moment of truth for our emergency plan.
questions.answerZh: 下星期的完整演習，應會是我們的緊急應變計劃真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The shop has tested its delivery system with practice orders. The first real order could show whether everything works properly.

questions.answer: The first real order could be the moment of truth for the shop’s new delivery system.
questions.answerZh: 第一張真正的訂單，可能會是店舖新送貨系統真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: The robot has passed several small tests. It is now ready to try carrying a full box.
questions.promptZh: 機械人已通過數項小測試。它現在已準備好嘗試搬運一個裝滿物品的箱子。
questions.answer: The robot has reached the moment of truth: it is ready to carry a full box.
questions.answerZh: 機械人已來到真正接受考驗的關鍵時刻：它準備搬運一個裝滿物品的箱子。
questions.targetMeaning: An important and decisive time when a person, plan, product, skill or effort is seriously tested, and the result, real quality or likely future becomes clear.

questions.prompt: A: When will we know whether the website works well on mobile phones? B: When customers try it on launch day.
questions.promptZh: 甲：我們何時才會知道網站在手機上是否運作良好？ 乙：等顧客在推出當日試用時便會知道。
